[[File:Ape Atoll Teleport (standard) icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Ape Atoll Teleport''' teleports the caster to [[Ape Atoll]], next to [[Hafuba]] in the safe upstairs section of the [[Temple of Marimbo]]. Players must have completed the [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing King Awowogei|Awowogei section]] of the [[Recipe for Disaster]] [[quest]] to use this spell; therefore the full requirements of this spell are the completion of [[Cook's Assistant]] and [[Monkey Madness I]], 70 [[Cooking]] (boostable), 48 [[Agility]], and 64 [[Magic]].

Note that the banana required for the spell must be unnoted.

This spell cannot be transferred into a [[Magic tablet|teleport tablet]], but it can be added to a [[Portal chamber|portal]] or [[portal nexus]] in the [[player-owned house|player owned house]].

Casting this spell is a requirement for the [[Hard Western Provinces]] diary.
